_how_to: Community events shown on the Community Events Board (Genesis Plaza). Times are ISO 8601 with a time zone (Z = UTC); every player sees them in their own local time. coordenadasDestino is the world position of the event stage: x = east/west, y = north/south on the top-view map (the world z axis). urlTransmissao: YouTube (watch, live or youtu.be link, or a channel live link), Twitch (channel or video link). X Spaces and Discord links cannot be embedded: the stage shows an 'Open stream' button instead.

events.descricao: Opening week of the new districts: music on the main stage, tours of the Candlestick Maze and the Mob Maze.
Watch the opening keynote live together. Stream from the official GitHub YouTube channel.
Second day of Universe: product sessions and community talks.
48 hours to build a district, a mini game or a tool for the Multiverse. Kickoff on the main stage.
Monthly meetup: show what you built, meet other devs, plan the next events.
